'''Beddek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Beddek was part of the team working on stabilizing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along with captured [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]].<ref name="TOR" />
